title: Ratchet the budget fence and guard the rule count
action: scripts/tests/test_agents_budget.mjs: (1) lower the thresholds so the win is locked rather than left to regrow into a fence that no longer bites -- set the hard budget and warn line from the ACHIEVED size plus deliberate headroom (state the chosen numbers and the headroom in a comment, and say why a fence far above the real size protects nothing); (2) add a structural check that the block still carries all 15 numbered critical rules, 1..15 with no gaps and no duplicates, so a later diet cannot silently drop one -- the failure message must name the missing number; (3) add a check that the four terminal-home rules (1, 5, 6, 11) and the Guardrails heading are present, since bee-hive/SKILL.md defers back to them and a pointer loop would leave the rule homeless. Include a negative control for the rule-count check (a fixture with rule 7 removed must fail it).

truths: The new thresholds are above the achieved size with stated headroom, and the reasoning is in the file.
The rule-count check fails, by number, on a fixture missing a rule.
The terminal-home check names which rule went missing.
prohibitions: Do NOT set a threshold so tight that ordinary rule additions fail it -- the fence guards regrowth, not growth.
Do NOT weaken any existing assertion in the suite.

trace.outcome: Budget fence ratcheted 20480/18000 -> 15000/14000, sized from the achieved 12692 B render with ~2.3 KB hard headroom and ~1.3 KB to the warn line, with the reasoning in the file: a fence 8 KB above the real size lets the file double before it bites. Added the structural guard the byte fence alone makes necessary — a budget rewards cutting and cannot tell 'cut 400 bytes of restated elaboration' from 'cut critical rule 7'. Three new checks: the 1..15 roster (no gaps, no duplicates, failure names the missing number, asserted on BOTH the template and the render); a negative control proving it; and a terminal-home check that rules 1/5/6/11 still state their rule rather than pointing outward, plus the Guardrails heading, since bee-hive/SKILL.md defers back to them. Scoping discovery: the roster must read only the ## Critical rules section — the first negative control blanked Startup step 7 instead of rule 7 and the check stayed green, so the section scoping is now proven, not assumed. 7 passed, 0 failed.
